description: React component for managing budgets in a frontend application, including listing, creating, editing, and deleting budgets with UI interactions and API calls.

methods.name: categoryName
methods.description: Returns the category name for a given category ID, or 'All' if not found.

methods.name: openCreate
methods.description: Prepares and opens the modal for creating a new budget.

methods.name: openEdit
methods.description: Prepares and opens the modal for editing an existing budget.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission for creating or updating a budget, with validation and API calls.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes a budget after user confirmation, with error handling.
